arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
work=$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-leads-optin-check.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$work"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch feat/official-optin-approval-20261031 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/telegram-robot-leads.git "$work"
cd "$work"
sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
test "$sha" = "41fe3c1de033294910ef50616855f1cd3da39873"
printf 'CHECKED_SHA=%s\n' "$sha"
git --no-pager diff --check HEAD
sudo -n -H /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -q
sudo -n -H /usr/bin/python3 -B -c 'import ast,pathlib; fs=("scripts/organic_growth.py","scripts/safe_runtime.py"); [ast.parse(pathlib.Path(p).read_text()) for p in fs]; print("SOURCE_AST_PASS")'
node --check ecosystem.config.js
echo OFFICIAL_OPTIN_REGRESSION_PASS
